summary: The note describes a community series of mindfulness and stress management workshops starting September 1, 2023, running through November. Each session is led by a different specialist covering topics such as mindfulness basics, stress tools, daily-life practice, yoga, neuroscience, group meditation, cross-cultural approaches, technology and outdoor activities. The workshops emphasize experiential learning and community, aiming to help participants sustain mindful living.
one_line: A fall 2023 community workshop series teaches mindfulness and stress management through experiential sessions led by varied specialists, from psychology and yoga to apps and nature.
key_facts: The series of mindfulness and stress management workshops begins September 1, 2023, as fall starts.
Dr. Jonas Sutherland, a psychologist specializing in mindfulness-based stress reduction, leads a workshop on September 10th and calls mindfulness "the art of conscious living."
Stress management specialist Elina Tran hosts a two-day event on September 20-21 teaching deep breathing exercises, progressive muscle relaxation and positive visualization.
Michael Johnson's seminar on September 27th shows how mindful eating, walking or housework can become acts of meditation.
Certified yoga instructor Aria Kim introduces mindful yoga on October 3rd, connecting breath with movement.
Dr. Elliot Reed, a neuroscientist, lectures on October 15th about neuroplasticity and mindfulness, including reduced grey matter density in stress and anxiety-related brain areas.
Community leader and activist Laura Smith holds a group meditation and sharing circle on October 22nd.
Martial arts master and Zen practitioner Kenji Matsuo speaks on November 1st about how martial arts can inform mindfulness practice.
Tech entrepreneur and app developer Sophia Chang guides participants through mindfulness apps and online resources on November 10th.
Mindfulness coach Mark Thompson leads an outdoor retreat in the scenic local park on November 20th.
The workshops are structured around experiential learning, combining interactive discussions, live demonstrations and guided practices.
